**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The fix is the smallest correct one: the bore opts into the ring ramp that #1609 built (`with_ring_zig`, one call in `bore.rs`). The ramp angle is the existing transition angle. No new parameter. This matches issue #1665 "Expected" and the law the Circular already keeps.
- The too-short case is refused by name, not silent. `plan_zig_capped` caps at 64 legs (`MAX_ZIG_LEGS`); above it the descent is `Descent::Sub` - a plunge at the plunge feed with an `entry:` note. Verified in `descent.rs` and `descent_dive.rs`.
- The ring restart plunge now gets an `entry:` note in `ladder_links.rs`. The moves do not change. The note says why the tool lifts and dives back down the column it just cut.
- The new suite pins the law, not the current numbers. Every descending feed move must satisfy `dz <= tan(ramp angle) * len`, and every axial move must run at the plunge feed with a note. The `ramps > 0` and `axial > 0` asserts stop a vacuous pass. The Ø7 chord (2 mm down over 0.2 mm) is 84 deg against the 3 deg bound, so the test fails on the old code by construction. The second test names the restart note. Each half of the fix is needed for one test to pass.
- `docs/decisions/1665-bore-ramp-angle.md` is present and matches the code, including the dropped options.

## Results (merged with main)

Built on the self-hosted runner through `pr-test.yml`, run 43625166739: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43625166739

- Head checked: `16b4bf0b017cfd732370af3f84eb39755ddf2799`. Trial merge with main `4f4edcf35`: clean, no conflicts.
- Quick gate, 0 failed: motion lib 341 passed (5 ignored); `bore_ramp_angle` 2; `center_cut_law` 6; `circular_ramp_angle` 2; `corner_blend` 14; `entry_approach` 9; `level_links` 12; `predrilled_entry` 6; `refusal_ghost` 3; `tiny_step` 3; `xy_arc_entry` 5; app `bore_entry` 4; app `ladder_entry_height` 4.
- Clippy `-p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

## Law checks

- Files under 400 lines after the change: `bore.rs` 352, `ladder_links.rs` 221, `descent.rs` 375, `levels.rs` 379.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests in the changed code. The test file's `expect("a legal bore")` is in a test.
- New test sits in `crates/motion/tests/`; it imports only `camcraft_motion` items, and its Gate map names that crate. Correct placement.
- No Cargo change, no new dependency, no golden, no snapshot PNG, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit.
- PR body: complete, `Changelog:` line present, ends `Fixes #1665` (correct issue number), conventional subject.
- Clean-room: the provenance comment names public ramp practice only.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Not exercised

- The app suites that build a bore through the document (`mill2d_c`, `operations`, app `level_links`) and the release heavy lanes did not run, here or on the runner. The posted G-code for a ramp-entry bore changes (zig legs replace one steep chord); no bore golden `.cl`/`.nc` exists, so no file check covers that stream. The suites that ran cover the generator and the entry law.
- The GUI was not started.
- Context: the post-merge batch run on main `4f4edcf35` was red, and issue #1690 tracks it as an sccache failure before the build. It is not a test failure, and it is not this PR.

## Notes

- The restart note fires on exact coordinate equality between the pass start and the tool position (`ladder_links.rs:188`). Both come from the same lattice, and the branch only adds a note, never a move. If equality ever misses, the move is still the named plunge of `feed_down`; the law cannot go silent.
- The decision file keeps "remove the hop" (stay down from sweep to ring) as a follow-up. Reasonable to defer.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
